Why the ferry fare doubled

The council raised the winter fare in one vote, and TAGGEDARTICLESENTINEL marks the paragraph that says so, for the capture to be checked by.

The ferry company had asked for a rise every winter for six years, and each year the council asked to see the logbooks of the three winters before, and each year the logbooks arrived a week after the vote.

Get the Harbor letter every Friday. NEWSLETTERBOXSENTINEL

This year the logbooks came first. They showed the boat running half empty from November to March, and the fare the company asked for was the one that would fill it.
